$comment: Every design of the site. scripts/release.mjs builds each old version into dist/<id>/ and points /classic/ and /prev/ at it; /versions/ lists them and the [ key steps back one version. To retire the current design: set its path to /<id>/, add the new one with path / and point current at it.

versions.name: Classic
versions.stack: Jekyll and Bootstrap 3, forked from Hux Blog
versions.line: A big photograph over every post, the posts in one column, and a switch between Chinese and English on the pages written in both.

versions.name: Collage
versions.line: Code, theatre and writing side by side, the production photographs at full size, and one accent colour picked for each visit.

previews.name: Daylight
previews.stack: The v2 pages in a new theme
previews.line: Cream and slate in the style of microsoft.ai, a serif for the headings, and a soft light under each hero that follows the pointer.
